description: This file defines logging-related classes, macros, and function declarations for a C++ project. It includes logging control classes, various log message classes (Startup, Shutdown, Notification, Crash, ParsingError, Error, Fatal), and a template class for categorized logging types. It also declares external functions for dumping exceptions, system files, and syslog entries, and defines a macro for conditional syslog logging based on category enablement.
